shadows.name: panel-offset
shadows.purpose: Structural lift for one signature workflow panel.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Short state transitions without decorative motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square high-confidence action with visible construction.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:46px; padding:0 18px; border:2px solid #1e2a21; border-radius:0; background:#121712; color:#f8fbf4; font:780 .88rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#242d25; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a9881e; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square field for concise, explicit data collection.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#121712; font:780 .88rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:48px; padding:12px 14px; border:2px solid #1e2a21; border-radius:0; background:#f8fbf4; color:#121712; font:400 1rem Charter,Cambria,serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a9881e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact technical navigation with direct text links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:24px; color:#121712; font:680 .88rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:.08em; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a9881e; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: Docs Forge uses the visual language of a durable technical handbook laid over graph paper. Serif editorial weight gives explanations authority, while sans-serif labels and monospace commands identify actions and machine-readable details.

rules.name: The Printed Limit Rule
rules.body: Accent colors mark meaning. They never become decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Voice Switch Rule
rules.body: Serif explains. Sans labels actions. Monospace shows commands and machine output.

dos: Do show commands and workflow state as inspectable technical material.
Do keep optional tracking and communications choices explicit and unticked.
